answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The prism of work and the basalt of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a mirror to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
